narrative.gap_prioritization_md: This section applies the Zennify Six-Factor Priority Formula to all below-median capabilities, producing a ranked priority register. The formula weights business impact (25%), risk exposure (20%), competitive gap (20%), effort inverse (15%), quick win potential (10%), and trend momentum (10%). Scores ≥8.0 = CRITICAL; 6.0-7.9 = HIGH; 4.0-5.9 = MEDIUM.
narrative.recommendations_md: Five recommendations are presented below, ranked by the Six-Factor Priority Score. Each recommendation is: (1) validated against IBKR's confirmed tech stack — every solution is confirmed absent before inclusion; (2) argued with IBKR-specific rationale that passes the specificity test — no generic prose; (3) mapped to specific evidence citations; and (4) scoped per zennify_solutions.md — no investment amounts per engagement framework rules. See Appendix C (Sub-Vertical Weights) and the Scoring Workbook for underlying data.
narrative.roadmap_md: This roadmap translates the five recommendations (Section 9) into an 18-month, three-phase sequencing plan designed for IBKR's operational realities: Soma Bulusu's modernization mandate, the National Trust Bank Charter OCC review (filed December 2025; OCC typically takes several months to review), the active FINRA 180-day certification, and the 79% pretax margin discipline that demands demonstrable ROI before phase escalation. No investment amounts are stated; scoping is subject to formal discovery (E-091, E-095).
